nav_total_exempt_days.2026-09-17: The vendor total value of the cutoff day and the separately captured live-fund value of that day disagree; both retired funds are zero, so the disagreement lies wholly in the live fund.

funding_attribution.note: The activity carries no link from a deposit or from fund proceeds to a fund purchase. Only an exact equal-amount pair seconds apart is a reallocation; every other amount is paired with the perimeter pseudo-account.

cash_residual.note: Deposits less net fund flows plus dividends less fee journals, against the provider settled cash. The activity does not explain it.

dividend_nav_treatment.note: Whether the dashboard value includes dividends cannot be told from the bytes; they are booked once as attributed income and are neither a flow nor added to NAV.
